# Blush

> > Blush is a customizable illustration platform that empowers designers and teams with editable, artist-created collections for every project.

Blush provides a curated marketplace of illustration collections from talented artists like Pablo Stanley, Isabela Humphrey, and Elina Cecilia Giglio. The platform combines design assets with collaboration features, integrating with popular tools like Figma and Sketch while offering flexible licensing for commercial use.

## Key Topics

- Illustration collections
- Customizable illustrations
- Artist portfolios
- Design assets
- Figma plugin
- Sketch plugin
- SVG illustrations
- Team collaboration
- Commercial licensing
- Pablo Stanley
- Design tool integration

- Illustration library

- Design inspiration

## Core Platform

- [Blush: Illustrations for everyone](https://blush.design): Blush homepage featuring the customizable illustration tool and artist collections
- [About Blush](https://blush.design/about): Company mission, team, and story behind Blush
- [Pricing and Plans](https://blush.design/plans): Subscription tiers, pricing options, and commercial licensing details

## Illustration Collections

- [All Collections on Blush](https://blush.design/collections): Browse all available illustration collections including Goodies, Hyperspace, and Moneyverse
- [The Jingle Jungle by Pablo Stanley](https://blush.design/collections/jingle-jungle): Christmas Critters collection featuring festive hand-drawn holiday illustrations
- [Tiny Little Xmas Parade by Pablo Stanley](https://blush.design/collections/xmas-parade): Festive collection with 18 editable Christmas parade illustrations
- [The Sad Snowman by Pablo Stanley](https://blush.design/collections/sad-snowman): Kind of Blue Snowman Illustration Pack with moody winter themes
- [Transhumans by Pablo Stanley](https://blush.design/collections/transhumans): Character illustration collection featuring futuristic humanoid designs

- [Isabela Humphrey](https://blush.design/artists/isabela-humphrey): Illustration portfolio from Mexico City-based artist Isabela Humphrey
- [Elina Cecilia Giglio](https://blush.design/artists/elina-cecilia-giglio): UX/UI design illustration collection from Elina Cecilia Giglio
- [Susana Ortiz](https://blush.design/artists/susana-ortiz): Floral and abstract illustration portfolio from Susana Ortiz
